name: Lovi
source:
"You're far from home, aren't you?"

Lovi is a visual novel inspired by Finno-Ugric myths and folklore relating to the Underworld, following the journey of a lost human. 

[From [url=https://lumi-lumo-art.itch.io/lovi-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你离家很远，是吗？”

《洛维》是一部视觉小说，灵感源自芬兰-乌戈尔神话和与地狱有关的民间传说，讲述了一个迷失人类的旅程。

[来自[url=https://lumi-lumo-art.itch.io/lovi-demo]itch.io[/url]]
